text: Ladies and gentlemen, step right up for a brand new challenger, hand-built by the boss of this building! Weighing in at six point six megabytes and standing one point eight two meters tall, this pressure fighter walks you down and throws you when you turtle. Approved at thirty three out of a hundred, with the only real face in the field, sitting on a pink mannequin body. Next time, real skin, real clothes, fix that neck seam, and chin up, friend, lift those eyes! Introducing The Face Off, THE OWNER!
